title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Strawberry Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Ice from Elfliq’s range of nic salt e-liquids is fabulously fruity vape with soft, sweet and juicy strawberries bursting with succulent summer sunshine and all shot through with an invigorating streak of crisp, cool menthol for maximum refreshment. Elfliq e-liquids are Elf Bar’s most iconic flavours in 10ml bottles of nicotine salt e-liquid. With a 50% VG / 50% PG concentration, Elfliq liquids produce a discreet amount of flavour-rich vapour with a smooth, comfortable throat hit, and provide rapid relief from nicotine cravings. Elfliq nicotine salt e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength and are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Pair this e-liquid with your refillable vapes or vape starter kits for effortless vaping.
